title: Google DeepMind puts SAE research on hold after SAEs lose to linear probes
byline: Lewis Smith, Senthooran Rajamanoharan, Neel Nanda and 5 others
summary: SAE probes did worse than plain linear probes at finding harmful intent in prompts.
points: They do not say that SAEs are useless.

quotes.text: Linear probes are actually really good and cheap and perform great
